definition_verbatim: Signal s = sign(close of the bar at O+29 = 08:59 minus open of the trade date's first bar), in vendor ticks. The first bar is the bar opening 17:00 CT on the CT calendar date before d that carries trade_date d (E.3-L-05, K7-L-01): Sunday 17:00 for a Monday in both regimes (from 2026-06-01 the weekend bars before it also carry Monday's trade date and are not read), and the Monday 17:00 bar for the trade date after a booked-forward Monday (the Sunday 17:00 bar of that trade date is not read). If that bar is missing there is no trade.
Both signal bars must be present and carry one instrument_id, else no trade (D6; E.3-L-06). Zero signal: no trade.
Entry: market intent on the bar at C-31 = 14:29 of CT date d (fills at the 14:30 open), buy if s > 0, sell if s < 0; that exact bar only (S0.6, E.3-L-04).

rows.side_rule: buy if s > 0, sell if s < 0
exit_rule_verbatim: Exit: market intent on the first present bar of CT date d at or after C-2 = 14:58 (fills nominally at the 14:59 open), resent while refused (S0.7, E.3-L-22). The engine's forced flatten at F and its D9.7 exit are the backstops; after either, the member sends nothing more that trade date.

definition_verbatim: Opening range: OR_high = max high, OR_low = min low of the present bars opening in [O, O+15) = [08:30, 08:45) of CT date d. No range bar: no trade (E.3-L-08). No minimum bar count and no instrument guard (D6 and B-H1 have none).
Buffer: 4 vendor ticks of the vehicle, 4 x 5.00 = 20.00 USD per bitcoin (K4-L-06; MBT is the exposure's only contract). Compared in integer vendor ticks (S0.10).
Eligible bars: those opening in [O+15, C) = [08:45, 15:00) of CT date d; no entry from 15:00 on.

Entry: the first eligible bar whose close >= OR_high + 4 ticks buys, <= OR_low - 4 ticks sells; a market intent on that bar. The first qualifying bar uses the trade date's one entry, whatever the engine does with the intent (E.3-L-08).

definition_verbatim: Daily bar of trade date d, from its bars on CT date d opening in [O, C) = [08:30, 15:00): H / L = max high / min low over the present bars, C_d = close of the bar at C-1 = 14:59. (O_d, the 08:30 open, enters no condition and is not read; the 08:30 bar must exist.)

Complete day (Family H): the 08:30 and 14:59 bars exist, no bar of CT date d carries early_halt_ct, and all bars in [08:30, 15:00) carry one instrument_id. It is finalised when a bar of a later trade date arrives, so day d's own bar never enters day d's condition.

d-1 = the most recent COMPLETE daily bar of an earlier trade date; incomplete days are dropped (E.3-L-09). For a Monday it is Friday's bar in both regimes; after a booked-forward Monday it is the Friday before (the holiday is not a trade date and its session is never a daily bar). None yet (warm-up, the window's start): no trade.

On the bar at O = 08:30 of CT date d (that exact bar, S0.6): no trade if it carries early_halt_ct (E.3-L-09, E.3-L-11); instrument guard: d-1's instrument_id must be the 08:30 bar's; Range = H - L of d-1 in ticks must be > 0; CLV = (C - L) / (H - L) in ticks, CLV >= 0.8 buys, CLV <= 0.2 sells (non-strict), else no trade. The cuts are compared exactly in integers (E.3-L-19). Market intent on the 08:30 bar (fills at the 08:31 open).
rows.trigger_event: trade date whose previous complete daily bar (08:30-15:00 CT) has CLV >= 0.8 or <= 0.2
rows.decision_time_ct: 08:30 (the 08:30 bar of CT date d; the signal itself is d-1's 08:30-14:59 daily bar), fill at the 08:31 open
rows.side_rule: CLV >= 0.8 buys, CLV <= 0.2 sells (non-strict), else no trade.
rows.side_kind: other: side = sign of the prior day's close location within its range (CLV >= 0.8 long, <= 0.2 short), i.e. continuation of the prior-day close location; not a trigger-day move
exit_rule_verbatim: Exit: market intent on the first present bar of CT date d at or after C-2 = 14:58 (fills nominally at the 14:59 open), resent while refused (S0.7, E.3-L-10, E.3-L-22). The engine's forced flatten at F and its D9.7 exit are the backstops; after either, nothing more that date.
rows.expected_events_per_year: trade dates with prior-day CLV in the tails; E.6 research screen: 101 trips over 265 trade dates

definition_verbatim: Dates: every trade date d in CRYPTO_FULL_SESSIONS and not in VENDOR_DEGRADED (S0.8).
Blocks from the anchor O = 08:30 (frozen day_session_ct): B1 = [08:30, 10:30), B2 = [10:30, 12:30), B3 = [12:30, 14:30).

Decision 10:30: r1 = close of the 10:29 bar - open of the 08:30 bar, in ticks; target1 = -sign(r1) x q; 0 if r1 = 0, if the 08:30 or 10:29 bar is missing, or if the 08:30 and 10:29 bars carry different instrument_ids. Decision 12:30: the same with the 10:30 and 12:29 bars.

Orders at each decision, decided at the close of the bar at decision - 1 min with the account's position then: hold if the target equals the position (the position is always 0 or +-q, so equal signs); otherwise, if a position is open, a flatten intent on that bar (fills at the decision-time open; if the bar is missing, on the first later present bar, with target 0, K7-L-08); then, if the target is nonzero, an entry intent on the decision-time bar (10:30 or 12:30, fills one minute later), sent only if the account is then flat, that bar exists and it carries the signal bars' instrument_id (S0.6, S0.9, K7-L-06).
rows.trigger_event: every full, non-degraded trade date: decisions at 10:30 (block 08:30-10:29) and 12:30 (block 10:30-12:29) with nonzero block return
rows.decision_time_ct: 10:29 and 12:29 (signal bars), entries on the 10:30 / 12:30 bars, fills one minute later
rows.intraday_hold: yes: up to 14:29 bar (final exit fills at 14:30 open)
exit_rule_verbatim: Final exit: market intent on the 14:29 bar, filling at the 14:30 open; if missing, the first later present bar (S0.7).
A position the engine closes before 12:30 leaves the account flat, and the 12:30 decision applies as written (K7-L-07). At most 2 entries a trade date.
rows.expected_events_per_year: every trade date with nonzero block return, at most 2 entries a date; E.6 research screen: 384 trips on 259 eligible dates (125 with two trips)

definition_verbatim: Dates: trade dates d that are Mondays, in CRYPTO_FULL_SESSIONS and not in VENDOR_DEGRADED (S0.8). A booked-forward Monday is not a trade date (its bars carry Tuesday's trade date) and does not trade.

Bars read: only bars with trade_date d opening at or after Sunday (CT date d-1) 17:00 and at or before Monday (CT date d) 13:59, each identified by CT date and clock. Weekend bars that carry Monday's trade date (from 2026-06-01) are never read.
Signal: s_t = sign(close of the bar at t - 1 min - open of the bar at t - 60 min), in ticks; 0 if either bar is missing or they carry different instrument_ids.

Flatten: at the close of the bar at t - 1 min, if a position is open and its sign differs from s_t (s_t = 0 included), a flatten intent on that bar (fills at the open of t); if that bar is missing, on the first later present bar, with s_t = 0. Hold if the signs are equal.

Entry: on the bar at t, if s_t is nonzero, the account is flat (no position, no pending order) and the bar at t exists and carries the signal bars' instrument_id, an entry intent of q in direction s_t (fills at t + 1 min) (S0.6, S0.9, K7-L-06).

rows.decision_time_ct: hourly t - 1 min bars: Sunday 17:59 .. Monday 12:59 (entries on the t bar, fill t + 1 min); latest 12:59 Monday
rows.side_rule: an entry intent of q in direction s_t (fills at t + 1 min); s_t = sign(close of the bar at t - 1 min - open of the bar at t - 60 min)
rows.intraday_hold: yes, within the Monday trade date (Sunday 18:01 CT at the earliest, final exit at Monday 14:00 open); spans CT calendar dates Sunday-Monday
exit_rule_verbatim: Final exit: market intent on Monday's 13:59 bar, filling at the 14:00 open; if missing, the first later present bar (S0.7).
A position the engine closes leaves the account flat; later decisions apply as written (K7-L-07). At most 20 entries a trade date.
